description: This file defines the interface IStorageManager within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace. It declares virtual methods for managing storage related to applications, such as creating, retrieving, deleting, and clearing storage. The interface is designed for implementation by other classes to handle storage management tasks in the system.

classes.name: IStorageManager
classes.description: Interface for managing application storage, providing methods to create, get, delete, and clear storage areas for apps.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates storage for an application given its ID and size, returning a path or an error reason.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the storage location, size, and used space for a given application ID, user ID, and group ID.

methods.name: DeleteStorage
methods.description: Deletes storage associated with a specific application ID.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears storage for a specific application, possibly for UI-triggered cleanup.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears storage for all applications except those explicitly exempted by their app IDs.
